name: fulguria

motion.feel: a System interface that glitches a little: at rest a rare one-frame tear or flicker (idle loop, asked for by the site); on hover a slice tears sideways, a light flickers or a stroke redraws; the press does the thing with a digital snap, no rubber

brief: Interface icons of Fulguria, an AMV team site and a clip contest dressed as the System of Solo Leveling. Cut like the Fulgur face: chamfers on the top-left / bottom-right diagonal, butt ends, miter joins, slanted square dots. One colour, the text colour.
